item.title: Microsoft launches AI cybersecurity model, agentic defense platform to cut enterprise security costs
item.description: Microsoft opened a new front in the AI security wars on Monday, unveiling its first custom-built cybersecurity model and a sweeping agentic defense platform — and making an argument that could reshape how enterprises buy AI: the future belongs not to the biggest model, but to the cheapest one that's good enough, routed intelligently.The company announced MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, a compact security model developed in-house by its Microsoft AI (MAI) division, embedded inside MDASH, Microsoft's multi-agent harness for finding and fixing software vulnerabilities. item.title: I tried to test China’s newest ChatGPT rival but couldn’t get in — and it exposed the next big problem facing the major AI players
item.description: I tried to test China’s newest ChatGPT rival but I couldn’t get in, and it's proof the AI race is no longer just about better models — it's about access.

item.title: I’ve spent months with the Honor Magic V6, and no other foldable can touch it for durability or battery life
item.description: The Honor Magic V6 is a superb foldable phone, with leading durability and battery life.

item.title: Wero passe un cap grâce à Decathlon qui adopte le service de paiement en Allemagne
item.description: Decathlon vient d'ajouter Wero, le paiement européen, sur sa boutique en ligne allemande. Une première pour un grand distributeur outre-Rhin, et un vrai test pour l'alternative maison à Visa, Mastercard et PayPal.

item.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
item.description: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.

item.title: Apple sued after alleged App Store crypto scam cost users $1.8M
item.description: Apple is facing a lawsuit from three users who say they collectively lost more than $1.8 million after downloading a fraudulent crypto wallet from the App Store, challenging the company’s longstanding claims that its app review process keeps users safe from scams.

item.title: Ce combo Anker (batterie 5000 mAh + chargeur 45W) bradé à -27 % est indispensable à mettre dans sa valise cet été
item.description: C'est l'un des combos les plus pratiques du moment : la batterie sans fil Anker Nano s'associe au chargeur rapide USB-C 45W de la marque. Parfait pour faire le plein d'énergie en un éclair et sans encombrement, ce duo profite d'une remise immédiate sur Amazon et tombe à seulement 65 euros au lieu de 89 euros.

item.title: Amazon’s new satellite network for mobile phones could turn up the heat on SpaceX
item.description: Amazon is expanding its plans for providing satellite connectivity to mobile phones.

item.title: Ukraine turns $200,000 AN-196 Liutyi kamikaze drone into reusable bomber to launch jet-powered missiles
item.description: Ukraine unveiled a reusable Liutyi drone carrying four missiles, replacing its previous one-way strike mission with reusable combat capability.

item.title: Antares raises $470M to build nuclear reactors for the US military
item.description: Antares has raised $470 million to build small modular reactors — 100 kW to 1 MW — for U.S. Air Force bases.

item.title: Thermostat connecté : Le guide complet pour une installation réussie avec Sowee [Sponso]
item.description: Posséder de vieux modèles de radiateurs n’empêche plus de passer au tout connecté dans votre logement. De nombreuses solutions compatibles existent et parmi elles, les thermostats connectés, comme ceux de Sowee by EDF. Faciles à installer, ils vous permettent de contrôler le chauffage depuis votre smartphone et faire des économies d’énergie.
